name: room-state
description: Add one SQLite-backed Durable Object per room with predefined, replaceable anonymous voting.

optionalSteps.name: progressive-interaction
optionalSteps.when: The target wants background form submission and fragment replacement.
optionalSteps.prompt: Do you want to apply the separate progressive-interaction kit while preserving the conventional GET/POST path?

docs: Document the room id as the Durable Object coordination key and SQLite as the vote authority.
Document the authorization boundary protecting reset, seed, and room-status composition.
Document accepted vote origins, voter-cookie lifetime, and the anonymous-cookie ballot-stuffing limitation.
Document the redacted room.reset event and the application's log destination.
Document which locked room revision is handed to model or presentation workflows.
Keep event-specific choices and seed data outside the kit.
notes: Seed replaces the predefined choice set, clears votes, opens the room by default, and advances its revision; reset clears votes but preserves choices and status.
The first-party voter cookie is opaque and the Durable Object stores only a per-room SHA-256 key.
The default HTTP route requires a same-origin vote Origin, accepts bounded application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies, and redirects with 303 after POST.
New voter cookies default to an eight-hour lifetime configurable at the HTTP composition boundary.
Reset logs include only mutation outcome, removed count, and resulting revision.
Worker-runtime coverage uses Istanbul because native V8 coverage is unsupported by the Cloudflare Vitest runtime.
